note: rustre-ttd-recorder is a workspace library crate (Time-Travel Debugging recorder: TtdPosition, CompressionLevel, TtdRecordConfig/Filter, RingBufferRecorder, RecordingSchedule, trace extension validation, ChaCha20Poly1305 nonce layout, RecordingMetrics, status/error variants). It is NOT exposed via the MCP server: no references to ttd-recorder/TtdRecord in crates/rustre-mcp-tools. JSON-RPC stdio comparison against rustre-mcp.exe is therefore N/A; the pure-logic Python validator IS the ground-truth comparison.

checked_against_source.TtdPosition: lexicographic (major,minor) ordering with start()=earliest()=(0,0) matches crates/rustre-ttd-recorder/src
checked_against_source.TtdRecordConfig::for_pid + validate: rejects empty output_dir, zero max_recording_size_mb, zero ring_buffer_mb
checked_against_source.TtdRecordFilter: include/exclude semantics on threads and modules
checked_against_source.RingBufferRecorder: VecDeque-style bounded ring (capacity 3, push 4 keeps last 3)
checked_against_source.RecordingSchedule: should_stop true when elapsed >= max_duration or position not strictly before stop_position
checked_against_source.nonce_layout: 8-byte salt || little-endian u32 counter = 12-byte ChaCha20Poly1305 nonce
